authority: spec/04_SEWCP-500_Electrostatic_Chuck.md Rev A (FROZEN) - EC-D01, EC-D02, EC-D15..EC-D19, section 6 (co-fired multilayer alumina, buried tungsten electrodes)

scope.bounded: The ceramic puck solid: O297.0 x 6.000, 3x O5.200 H8 lift-pin bores at O200 BC (30/150/270), central O1.50 He port. Datum: Z=0 at the bond face; mesa plane at 6.000 (+0.020 mesa height is a surface-texture land).
scope.modelling_conventions: The 20 um mesa array (EC-D04..EC-D07), seal band (EC-D08..EC-D10), buried tungsten electrodes (EC-D11..EC-D13), HV pads (EC-D20) and the He distribution groove (EC-D14 - its layout diameter is unstated) are co-fired/screened process layers and lapped surface textures: they are drawing/process callouts, not machinable solids, per the established mask-zone convention. EC-D19 chamfers defer to the drawing (no counterbore permitted - Paschen, DR-4).
scope.open_state: EC-D14 groove layout is a recorded requirement gap for the drawing stage. No dependency on ECR-Q-011, the CP path item, or CP-02.

requirements.statement: O297.0 x 6.000 puck; bond face at Z=0, mesa plane at 6.000.
3x O5.200 H8 lift-pin bores, through, O200 BC at 30/150/270; no counterbore permitted (Paschen, DR-4); 0.3 x 45 chamfers both ends per EC-D19 (drawing).
Co-fired multilayer alumina; screen-printed D-shaped tungsten electrodes at the 0.300 dielectric depth; mesas and seal band lapped to 0.010 TIR coplanarity at 20 um height.

interfaces.nature: Bond face to HP bond face (HP-IF-4)
O5.200 H8 guides over the O5.000 h6 pins - the guiding fit (DR-4 Paschen-safe)
